stage: D4-A5-R2 — Continuation Freeze and Accounting Contract Repair

audit_finding_repaired.finding: The committed R1 continuation path is internally non-executable (bootstrap deadlock).
audit_finding_repaired.deadlock: prepare-continuation-manifest created an untracked continuation manifest (dirty worktree), while execute_phase_p required the exact R1 HEAD with a completely clean worktree. Leaving the manifest uncommitted failed the cleanliness check; committing it changed HEAD away from the exact R1 commit and failed the freeze check. The focused Phase-P tests did not expose this because the real freeze gate was monkeypatched.
audit_finding_repaired.resolution: The continuation execution manifest is now a committed pre-exposure artifact of the R2 freeze commit itself; the old write-before-execution CLI bootstrap (prepare-continuation-manifest) is removed; the real continuation start is governed by a shared read-only preflight (verify-continuation-start) used by execute_phase_p itself.
